baseline: Uploaded console source dated 2026-10-04; static inspection, not a live run.

coverage_rules.automation: A requirement counts only after its browser handlers and all necessary assertions are implemented; contract examples alone do not count.
coverage_rules.verified: A requirement counts only when all required assertions passed on the reported app/backend build and browser profile.
coverage_rules.blocked: Skipped, blocked, xfail, not_run, lint-only, and BFF-only checks receive no verified credit.
coverage_rules.separation: Keep real-backend journeys and controlled-response UI-state results distinguishable.
coverage_rules.denominator: Freeze the agreed in-scope requirement inventory before advertising a percentage; retain gaps and exclusions.
